trap-superlative.evidence: 'Lithium-6 ... is the lightest nucleus beyond the doubly-magic helium-4 core'; 'The fifth nucleon still uses a Hopf link, riding the stability of the doubly-magic core'; and item 4's internal contradiction.
trap-superlative.notes: THREE separate problems, none fixable inline. (1) A=5 nuclides DO exist (5He, 5Li, both particle-unbound), so 'the lightest nucleus beyond He-4' is false as written -- the true claim needs 'stable'. (2) The block's own extracted table builds A=5 as pppnn = 5Li, which is proton-unbound with a ~10^-22 s lifetime, so 'riding the stability' describes an unbound intermediate. (3) Item 4 says 'The nucleus absorbs the trefoil deficit' and two sentences later 'the nucleus is a trefoil supplier, not a deficit-bearer' -- absorbing and supplying are opposite. VERIFIED SOUND separately: the NF coefficients sum to exactly the stated net 2.754 and L_- is genuinely the largest.
